nodes.label: Reviewed retained semantic extraction
nodes.rationale: Retain source hashes and honest usage availability so public CI can replay reviewed extraction without calling a model API.

nodes.label: Explicit template upgrade
nodes.rationale: Review old and new commits, compatibility, authority, tools, data handling and lifecycle before acceptance; preserve consumer custom rules.

nodes.label: Exact source pinning
nodes.rationale: Record exact commits and per-file SHA-256 values; branch HEAD must not act as an implicit update channel.

nodes.label: Consumer adoption
nodes.rationale: Root consumer instructions must point to the rendered version; merely retaining unused files is not adoption.

nodes.label: Housekeeper loop
nodes.rationale: Keep engineering records consistent while preserving approved archives, recovery and user data; propose cleanup with exact paths and retention policies.

nodes.label: Consumer project rules
nodes.rationale: Consumer rules may tighten the owner boundary but cannot silently weaken it or treat the template as tool permission.

nodes.label: Simple dependable recoverable game entry
nodes.rationale: Maintain the launcher and engineering record while protecting user data and source provenance.
